title: Canonical common-exponent scalar coefficient tensors
statement: For finite commutative rings A,B and φ:A→B, a positive common annihilator N, and a scheme T with N invertible, use the uniquely generator-normalized Tate balancing furnished by [lem-pur-finite-tate-scalar-source-normalization]. The existing VectorTraceScalar.balancing selects that unique family, line shifts its degree-one derived-single map by two, and unit is the multiplication-normalized scalar unit transported by the single/unit identifications [def-pur-vector-purity-scalar-single]. The existing VectorTraceScalar.base recursively starts at unit and at each successor applies the scalar tensorator, the preceding map in the first tensor argument, and line in the second. Its source and target are the ordered affineLinearBaseCoefficient objects [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action]. All arrows are the already published constructions; no new choices or replacement objects are introduced.
